reports.title: WATTS WATER TECHNOLOGIES REPORTS RECORD THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is increasing its full year sales and organic sales growth outlook as well as its operating margin and adjusted operating margin outlook. Full year sales growth is expected to range from up 17% to 18% on a reported basis and up 11% to 12% on an organic basis. Full year operating margin is expected to be between 21.6% and 21.7%, or up 320 to 330 basis points, and adjusted operating margin is expected to be between 20.3% and 20.4%, or up 70 to 80 basis points. The full year outlook ranges are approximate, and assume no change in the level of impact resulting from the Middle East conflict, incorporate the estimated impact of tariffs in place or announced, and adjusted results exclude the impact of tariff refunds and related interest income.
